title: Scientific Ontology (SO) / 存在境界論: Public Edition v4.2.0
description:
Scientific Ontology (SO) / 存在境界論 Public Edition v4.2.0 strengthens the public interface for boundary-oriented conceptual research.

This release clarifies why physics-adjacent vocabulary appears in the framework, adds the Boundary Realism Principle to the public Sat / Truth layer, reorganizes the Research Notes Index, and introduces a broader Claim Strength and Publication Layer Table for managing exploratory notes, stronger hypotheses, cross-domain readings, and public-facing claim boundaries.

Major additions include the Physics Correspondence Policy, Boundary Realism Principle, Cross-Domain Ontological Notes, Japanese / English separated renderings for PINGER and Chaos / Logical-depth Axis notes, a literary-ontological note on Meifu Bureau / reincarnation / belief gravity, and public-format checking tools.

Scientific Ontology is a boundary-oriented conceptual framework for studying existence, history, communication, meaning, ethics, AI applications, physics-adjacent correspondence, literary ontology, and institutional interpretation through iterative publication, practical application, and conceptual refinement.
notes: This release strengthens the public interface for physics correspondence, boundary realism, Research Notes navigation, and claim-strength / publication-layer management while preserving the publication policy, public/private boundary, terminology governance, and CC BY 4.0 licensing established in earlier public editions. Earlier releases remain archived within the Zenodo record family for historical continuity.
